thresholds.rule: keep=argmax e_i iff e1>=tau_hi and e1-e2>=tau_m; else ABSTAIN (draft §2.2); the zone-v1 leg precedes the model leg and refuses only
thresholds.fit: train-only 5-fold CV by clusters, pairwise-disjoint folds, seed 42; NO sealed surface used for any choice (N2); CV readers measure the MODEL leg only (the zone does not make the riders green)

constants.position: leg 3.5 of §5.1: between the CH-2 refusal and the model leg
constants.pairness: evaluates the PAIR cos of the candidate (nano, norm1); any unordered pair of the cluster inside the zone fires

zone_v1.provenance: ADDENDUM-6 §2 pos 1 (MLC 30.10 round 6, 3/3; commit f2b51bd): constants derived from the structural train-support voids train-only before seal and fixed by ratification (owner directive 30.10: constants already fixed — not re-derived); §1 legality: structural + one-sided (refusal-only) + indivisible package with the train extension + zone-off probe
zone_v1.residual_risk: max char5 of the refused class 0.04947 -> margin to tau_lex 0.05 is 0.0005 with zeps=1 (the OR-leg does not insure it); accepted in frozen-doc zone-v1
known_uncovered: cos < 0.60 entirely (below the corpus coverage floor — no train support)
char5 > 0.20 AND cos <= 0.85 AND zeps < 3 (residual band above the OR-leg)
monolingual near-boundary pairs outside the TT/NT forms
zone_v1.pairness: evaluates the PAIR cos of the candidate (nano + norm1, the SAME convention as e_cos); any unordered pair of the cluster inside the zone fires
